{"metadata":{"description":"Refreshable Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI — phone access with QR + embedded login","id":"gh:1343656184","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"phone-tunnel-pool","slug":"iimaguest/phone-tunnel-pool","topics":["cloudflare","dsh","dsh-plugin","quick-tunnel","web-gui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Refreshable Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI — phone access with QR + embedded login"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# phone-tunnel-pool — Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Enable/disable a **self-healing Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool** for
`http://127.0.0.1:3080` (the Deep"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"Seek Harness web GUI) from a floating widget
with a scannable QR code. One scan from your phone, and"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" the pool keeps
itself alive:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Generational rotation (12h):** a new pair of tunnels spawns on schedule;
older generations stay "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"alive while anything is still on them.
- **Chase service worker:** every origin your browser touches"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" registers a
service worker. Dead or rotated hostnames redirect to a live sibling or the
newest prim"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ary — the same open tab survives generation changes as long as
it stays connected.
- **Prompt-free m"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"igrations:** the proxy injects credentials only into pages it
has already authenticated; before any "},{"id":"p5s6","text":"redirect the watchdog pre-authenticates
the target hostname (minting its auth cookie), so migrations"},{"id":"p5s7","text":" land
authenticated — no "Authentication required" popups.
- **Usage-based retirement:** generations"},{"id":"p5s8","text":" retire only when idle
(no tabs / websockets / recent traffic) or at a hard age cap.
- **Respawn wit"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"h backoff:** dead tunnels are replaced with new hostnames;
quick-tunnel mint quota (Cloudflare 429) "},{"id":"p5s10","text":"is respected via exponential
backoff + a 2-probe dead-grace (DNS propagation)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Extra: the daemon runs detached and **adopts** across `dsh web` restarts, so
the same URL, password "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"and QR stay valid until you click Disable — no
re-scan (an OS reboot still costs one fresh scan; a n"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"amed tunnel removes even
that — see `PLAN.md` §7)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install / Uninstall"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"After install: open the widget → **Enable** → scan the QR with your phone
camera. Install/remove rec"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"oncile `dsh.profile.bundles` against the installed
state automatically — **never edit `~/.dsh/profil"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"es/web/package.json` by hand**;
a stray bundle entry with no matching dependency is exactly the kind"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" of state
that fails profile boot ("cannot resolve profile bundle")."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Prerequisites (all of them)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| What | Needed? | Who provides it |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| `dsh web` running on its default port **3080** (`DSH_TARGET_PORT` to override) | required | you (t"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"he plugin tunnels *to* it) |
| `cloudflared` binary on PATH | required | you — `brew install cloudfl"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ared` (or apt/dnf/Chocolatey, or set `DSH_CLOUDFLARED` to the existing binary) |
| Node.js runtime |"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" required | dsh itself — no separate install (the daemon reuses dsh's node) |
| `python3` + `qrcode`"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" package | optional | you — `pip install qrcode`; without it the widget shows URL + login instead of"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" a scannable QR |
| `caffeinate` | optional | macOS ships it; skipped elsewhere |
| PowerShell | opt"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ional | Windows ships it — used only for process cleanup on Windows (no `pkill` there) |
| Outbound "},{"id":"p12s8","text":"network | required | cloudflared → Cloudflare edge on 443/7844 (no inbound port needed) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The widget **preflights these on dsh web start** and shows a yellow warning
line (with the exact fix"},{"id":"p13s2","text":", e.g. `brew install cloudflared`) before you even
click Enable; the daemon also fails fast with a r"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"eadable error if cloudflared
is missing at Enable time, and `refresh` in the popup re-checks everyth"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ing —
a stale error clears once the prereqs pass."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The feature flag set is version-gated on `cloudflared --version`:
2024.6+ enables the opt-in post-qu"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"antum handshake (`DSH_PQ=1`), 2024.8+ adds
`--management-diagnostics=false`; older builds (apt/dnf p"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ackages) get a
reduced, compatible flag set."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Platforms.** macOS, Linux and Windows (Windows uses PowerShell for process
cleanup; `caffeinate` i"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"s macOS-only and silently skipped elsewhere). The
daemon's state file and log live in the per-OS tem"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"p directory
(`os.tmpdir()`); the widget settings file (`iptunnel-settings.json`) lives in
`~/.dsh`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### The dsh 0.2 launch token (why the tunnel 401'd)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"dsh 0.2 moved web auth into the connection service: the desktop URL carries a
per-process launch tok"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"en (`http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=<secret>`), a valid
token exchange mints a signed browser-session "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"cookie, and every request with
neither gets `401`. The tunnel path is phone → trycloudflare → this p"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"roxy →
the GUI, and a phone can never learn a token that only exists in the desktop
process output —"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" so on 0.2 the tunnel answered 401 all the way down."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The fix (0.3.35): the plugin reads the token through the connection service's
public `authenticatedU"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rl()` API and hands it to the proxy — via the daemon
environment on a fresh enable, and via `POST /i"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ptunnel/__ctl/launch-token`
whenever a surviving daemon outlives a dsh restart (the token is
per-pro"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"cess, the daemon is deliberately not). The proxy exchanges the token
against the GUI once, holds the"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" resulting session cookie, and stamps it onto
every forwarded request and websocket handshake — re-m"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"inting on an upstream
401 and on every token push. A phone therefore presents only this proxy's
Basi"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"c auth, exactly as before, and the launch token never reaches cloudflared's
environment, the QR, or "},{"id":"p18s8","text":"the published URL. On a dsh without the gate the token
is empty, every new code path no-ops, and for"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"warding is byte-identical to the
pre-0.2 behaviour (`test/launch-token.test.mjs` pins all of this ag"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"ainst a
mock origin, including rotation)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- The password is **generated per Enable**, held in memory, shown in the
widget and embedded in the "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"QR; nothing is committed or published. (The
daemon keeps the *current* credentials in a `0600` state"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" file under the OS
temp dir so the tunnel survives a dsh web restart; that file is deleted on
disabl"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"e.)
- `/iptunnel/*` service paths (health, sw-config, sw.js, entry, watchdog.js,
telemetry, preauth)"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" are **public by necessity** — browsers fetch service
workers without credentials; they carry hostna"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"mes and pool liveness only.
The credential handoff (`/iptunnel/preauth`) mints a cookie only for a
c"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"aller presenting the valid password; it never echoes anything.
- `window.__ptAuth` is injected **onl"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"y into HTML the proxy has authenticated**.
- The proxy listens on 127.0.0.1; public network exposure"},{"id":"p20s9","text":" happens only
through the tunnel hostnames — **the QR/hostname is a bearer secret**
(anyone who gets"},{"id":"p20s10","text":" it can open the tunnel while enabled): disable when done.
- Quick tunnels are testing-grade (no upt"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"ime SLA, per-IP mint quota).
The repo-agnostic sibling package
carries the same pattern for any loca"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"l port; a named tunnel is the
lifetime endgame (one stable hostname → no re-scans, no prompts, no qu"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"t; a named tunnel is the
lifetime endgame (one stable hostname → no re-scans, no prompts, no quota)."}],"truncated":true}
